title: Exclude directory aliases from local overlap evidence
body:
The local overlap search checks only whether each note itself is a symlink. A linked package or ledger directory can therefore supply external bytes as local research evidence. Use the existing repository path validator for every note, including parent components. A skipped tracked note remains an explicit coverage gap.

Validation: all 99 overlap-consumer tests pass on Python 3.12. Four new tests also pass under `-O`, covering external and internal directory aliases, linked leaf files, non-file notes, a linked checkout root, a linked ledger directory, and a tracked note whose parent is replaced by a link. `git diff --check` passes. Native Windows junction behavior uses the existing shared validator; no native Windows run was made.

Overlap: refreshed main and priority revision 7; live open-PR paths and recent Discussions checked. PR5723 and PR5724 touch separate parts of this tool. This PR is independent of both. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `c0610143960f61d9fc44b2cf4e531e6a2d5eef39`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
